# DNS.usectl.com

> DNS.usectl.com is a zero-bloat, ad-free global DNS propagation radar and live nslookup cross-check workstation for developers, DevOps, and cloud engineers.
> Part of the usectl.com infrastructure suite.

## Quick Links
- Canonical Website: https://dns.usectl.com/
- Full Technical Specification: https://dns.usectl.com/llms-full.txt
- Resolver Dataset (JSON): https://dns.usectl.com/data/resolvers.json
- Open Graph / Social Card: https://dns.usectl.com/og-image.png
- GitHub Source Repository: https://github.com/j3dyy/dns-check
- Ecosystem Root: https://usectl.com/

## URL Parameters & Deep Linking
- `https://dns.usectl.com/?d={domain}`: Preset domain query (e.g. `usectl.com`, `github.com`)
- `https://dns.usectl.com/?d={domain}&t={type}`: Query specific record type (`A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `TXT`, `NS`, `CAA`, `SOA`, `PTR`)
- `https://dns.usectl.com/?view=nslookup`: Open directly into the split-screen nslookup Cross-Check terminal workstation
- `https://dns.usectl.com/?inspect={resolverId}`: Automatically open the Slide-Over nslookup Overlay Drawer for a specific node (e.g. `cloudflare`, `google`, `quad9`)

## Supported DNS Record Types
- `A` (1): IPv4 32-bit host addresses
- `AAAA` (28): IPv6 128-bit host addresses
- `CNAME` (5): Canonical name aliases
- `MX` (15): Mail exchange hosts with preference weights
- `TXT` (16): SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and domain verification tokens
- `NS` (2): Authoritative nameservers
- `CAA` (257): Certificate Authority Authorization policies
- `SOA` (6): Start of Authority zone metadata & serial timers
- `PTR` (12): Reverse DNS pointer mapping

## Monitored Global Edge Resolvers
- **Global Anycast**: Cloudflare (1.1.1.1), Google Public DNS (8.8.8.8), Quad9 (9.9.9.9)
- **North America**: OpenDNS / Cisco (208.67.222.222), Control D US East (76.76.2.0), CIRA Canadian Shield (149.112.121.10)
- **Europe**: DNS.SB Frankfurt (185.222.222.222), CleanBrowsing Vienna (185.228.168.9), AdGuard Amsterdam (94.140.14.14), Hurricane Electric Frankfurt (74.82.42.42)
- **Asia & Pacific**: AliDNS Hangzhou (223.5.5.5), DNS.SB Singapore (185.222.222.222), Control D Tokyo (76.76.2.0), Control D Sydney (76.76.2.0)
- **Latin America & Africa**: Control D São Paulo, Control D Johannesburg

## Key Capabilities
1. **nslookup Cross-Check Workstation**: Real-time terminal interface side-by-side with automatic consensus response clustering to instantly spot propagation splits.
2. **Slide-Over Overlay Drawer**: Inspect authentic monospaced `nslookup` and `dig` outputs for any edge resolver with one click.
3. **UDP Port 53 Raw Socket Engine**: High-speed RFC 6891 EDNS0 4096-byte UDP socket resolution (`/api/dns`) eliminating browser CORS constraints.
4. **Expected Value Diffing**: Compares live returned records against expected values, highlighting stale caches with exact remaining TTL.
5. **SSL/TLS Telemetry**: Automatic certificate handshake inspecting expiration countdown, issuing CA, SAN domains, and cipher suites (`/api/ssl`).
